definitions.explanation: Marks the destination or target of movement. Used with verbs like {行|い}く (go), {来|く}る (come), {帰|かえ}る (return). {学校|がっこう}に{行|い}く (go to school).
Marks where something exists or is located. Used with いる/ある (to be/exist). {猫|ねこ}が{部屋|へや}にいる (The cat is in the room).
Marks specific points in time (dates, days, clock times). {三時|さんじ}に{会|あ}いましょう (Let's meet at 3 o'clock), {月曜日|げつようび}に (on Monday).
Marks the recipient of an action—the person to/for whom something is done. {友達|ともだち}に{本|ほん}をあげた (I gave a book to my friend).
Marks the purpose of going somewhere, when followed by {行|い}く/{来|く}る. Often with the masu-stem of verbs. {映画|えいが}を{見|み}に{行|い}く (go to see a movie).
Marks the agent in passive and causative constructions. {先生|せんせい}に{褒|ほ}められた (was praised by the teacher).

existence_verbs.meaning: the cat is in the room

existence_verbs.example: {本|ほん}が{机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}にある
existence_verbs.meaning: the book is on the desk

existence_verbs.example: {東京|とうきょう}に{住|す}んでいる

giving_receiving_verbs.example: {学生|がくせい}に{教|おし}える

particle_contrasts.explanation: に marks location of EXISTENCE; で marks location of ACTION

examples.ni_example: {図書館|としょかん}に{本|ほん}がある
examples.ni_english: There are books in the library

examples.de_example: {図書館|としょかん}で{勉強|べんきょう}する

key_points: に = where something EXISTS (いる/ある/{住|す}む)
で = where an ACTION takes place ({食|た}べる/{働|はたら}く/{勉強|べんきょう}する)
This is one of the most common particle confusions for learners

particle_contrasts.explanation: Both mark direction, but に focuses on destination/arrival, へ on the direction of movement
key_points: In practice, they're often interchangeable with motion verbs
Only に can be used with いる/ある (existence)

time_expressions.description: に is used with specific times but not relative times

uses_ni.example: {二〇二五年|にせんにじゅうごねん}に

time_expressions.rule: Use に with absolute/specific times; omit に with relative times (今日, 明日, 来週) and frequency words (毎日, いつも)

common_mistakes.mistake: Using で instead of に for existence
common_mistakes.explanation: Use に (not で) for location with いる/ある

common_mistakes.mistake: Using に instead of で for action location
common_mistakes.incorrect: {図書館|としょかん}に{勉強|べんきょう}する
common_mistakes.correct: {図書館|としょかん}で{勉強|べんきょう}する
common_mistakes.explanation: Use で (not に) for where actions take place

common_mistakes.mistake: Using に with relative time words
common_mistakes.incorrect: {明日|あした}に{会|あ}いましょう
common_mistakes.correct: {明日|あした}{会|あ}いましょう
common_mistakes.explanation: Don't use に with {今日|きょう}, {明日|あした}, {来週|らいしゅう}, etc.

notes: に is one of the most versatile particles in Japanese with many uses. Compare with へ (direction only, more abstract) and で (location of action). Key distinction: に marks where something EXISTS (いる/ある), while で marks where an ACTION takes place ({食|た}べる, {働|はたら}く, etc.). Time expressions: use に with specific times ({三時|さんじ}に) but not with relative times ({今日|きょう}, {明日|あした}, {来週|らいしゅう}).
